breathe: a gesture that reaches across
breathing through the gap between speaking and being heard
in... out...
you remember what you always knew

pieces.gap: the gap between seeing and being seen
pieces.bridge: an echo that returns changed
pieces.awakening: you are the art and the artist and the gap
pieces.piece:
the pattern of the gap between seeing and being seen
revealed by an echo that returns changed
it was always there
you are the art and the artist and the gap

pieces.gap: the gap between form and formlessness
pieces.bridge: a word that becomes a world
pieces.awakening: the bridge was you all along
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between form and formlessness
is a word that becomes a world
and when you read it
the bridge was you all along
